* Keep track of the condition of your teeth! *

You can select and save the condition of each tooth, such as "healthy tooth," "cavity," "denture," etc. The tooth condition is indicated by color-coding on the screen.

* Keep track of the treatment history and notes of your teeth! *

For each tooth, you can edit and save text. You can keep track of various information such as the history of dental treatment, detailed condition, and dates when the teeth grew or fell out of the teeth.

* Output an image and share it on social media! *

The condition and notes of the teeth can be saved as an image in the device and shared through various social media, such as Instagram, Twitter, Facebook and LINE.

* Switch between permanent and milk teeth display! *

You can switch between displaying both permanent and milk teeth, permanent teeth only, and milk teeth only.

* Customize left-to-right flipping and dental notation! *

You can customize whether to flip horizontally and the dental notation method (FDI notation, Universal Numbering System, or Zsigmondy-Palmer notation) that indicates the location of the teeth.

* 15 languages are supported! *

This app supports 15 languages: English, French, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Spanish, German, Russian, Portuguese, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Arabic, Hindi, Thai and Vietnamese.
